en: A monochrome image printed across two panels showing a long, low, whitewashed adobe or plastered building with a shaded veranda supported by posts. The structure has exterior stair-like buttresses around a window and a simple wooden railing along the porch. In the foreground are sparse shrubs and an unpaved yard or driveway. To the left stands a very tall, thin agave (century plant) flower stalk, and in the distant background low mountains or hills are visible. In the upper right corner the red number "6713" is printed. There is no other visible text or decorative border.
